name: io.github.andrewschristison/pondlog-pondlog
description: Aggregate nature MCP server. One tool call returns a unified briefing — birds, wildlife, plants, tides, streamflow, night sky, and phenology — stitched from six public APIs (iNaturalist, eBird, NOAA, USGS, NPN, astronomy-engine). Partial failures are reported in errors[] without crashing the briefing.

environment_variables.name: EBIRD_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Free eBird API key (https://ebird.org/api/keygen). Optional. Without it the eBird section is omitted from the briefing; other sources still work.

environment_variables.name: NOAA_STATION
environment_variables.description: NOAA CO-OPS tide station id (6–8 digits). Optional. Without it tides are omitted.

environment_variables.name: USGS_SITE
environment_variables.description: USGS streamgauge site number (8–15 digits). Optional. Without it streamflow is omitted.
